done_when: forge migrate keeps a file under an old-Forge folder when a tracked file outside the old-Forge folders references its path, and a test proves it

findings.body: The adapter exclusion leaves the requested behavior broken for referenced client content at `.codex/skills/forge/SKILL.md`. When tracked `package.json` references that customized file, migration still moves its content into `.forge-migrate/kept/` and replaces the original path. `_apply` calls `sync.write` at src/forge/migrate.py:746; src/forge/sync.py:271 supplies the replacement and :305 writes it. The package therefore reads different content after migration despite its reference remaining unchanged. The new test explicitly expects this failure at tests/test_fix_forge_migrate_sets_aside_client_owned_fi.py:27–28. Preserve the referenced content at its original path through sync and update the command-level test to require that outcome.
